title: Scalar treatment cures Herrera's dog's bladder mass

tellings.quote: and they did this with my dog for example because he would like I said he was diagnosed with some sort of bladder mass that they thought was cancerous

plain: A man named Michael Herrera, who says he once saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says a treatment he calls scalar cured his dog. He says the dog had been diagnosed with a mass in its bladder that vets thought was cancer, and that this treatment was used on him. Herrera tells it as his own experience, as proof that the technology heals.
